guide_creation.whole_body_keys:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Redraw supplied fullbody sprite sheet into EIGHT complete whole-character KEYFRAMES, 4columns x2rows. Preserve THIS wholecharacter silhouette, proportions, simple white top, blonde head/face, navy skirt, chunky boots, tail and45-degree right-facing angle. Keep every wholefigure same size with modest hair/cloth followthrough. Transparent background.
Crucial corrective focus: previous16 drawing sheet repeated one leading leg. New8 drawings are ONE actual two-step cycle, not two repeats. Clearly alternate anatomical leg identity, fixed near leg foreground and far leg background.
Use near-leg boot a consistent MEDIUM BROWN #655044; far-leg boot a consistent DARK BROWN #342C29. Near thigh has same medium-gray and far thigh darker charcoal. NO changing which boot has which shade. Near leg always drawn over far leg at crossing. Leg roots stay at their OWN hip, do not swap hip attachments:
0 NEAR lighter boot leads forward to RIGHT. FAR dark boot behind to LEFT. 
1 NEAR lighter boot supports planted under hips; FAR dark foot bends and lifts behind.
2 NEAR lighter foot remains planted under hips; FAR dark knee and foot pass FORWARD toward right, far foot lifted visibly off floor behind foreground near leg.
3 FAR DARK boot forward toward RIGHT, nearing contact. NEAR LIGHT boot trailing toward LEFT, toe still touching floor, drawn in foreground.
4 FAR DARK BOOT now fully extended to RIGHT/front on floor. NEAR LIGHT boot at LEFT/back, toe off, foreground. This is the OPPOSITE leading leg to0. Do not repeat0!
5 FAR DARK boot supports planted under hips; NEAR LIGHT foot bends and lifts behind, foreground.
6 FAR DARK boot remains planted under hips; NEAR LIGHT knee/foot pass FORWARD toward right, lifted off floor IN FRONT of far calf.
7 NEAR LIGHT boot extends toward RIGHT/front preparing landing; FAR DARK boot trailing LEFT toe-on, behind. Leads back to0.
All8 closed eyes and puckered pout, hands behind, whole head/torso/skirt/tail/boots drawn together. Subtle sleeve/hem/hairtip motion appropriate to each stance. NO detached or pasted body layers, no enlargedhead or slenderlegs. Simple flat reference palette; ONE large shadow on white shirt, not fabric folds. Keep fullbody isolated in EACH cell with comfortable transparent margins top, bottom and sides, no clipping, no background, no grid, no text, no colored markers.
guide_creation.whole_body_passing_poses:
Create a NEW animation drawing sheet, NOT a copy or retouch of the input poses. The input shows the identity and eight key walking poses; your eight poses must occupy the GAPS between these poses. 4columns2rows, eight complete wholebody characters, transparent background. Read cells left-to-right top-to-bottom.
Draw these precise NEW inbetween poses:
0: near lighter boot is halfway retracting from far right toward pelvis; its sole now FLAT on ground, leg more vertical. Far dark foot is lifting behind, heel high, toe peeling off. Feet noticeably CLOSER than input0, unlike the input's wide stride.
1: near LIGHT boot supports VERTICALLY directly under near hip, flat on floor. Far DARK knee swings forward, its folded boot is tucked CLOSE to supporting calf, directly UNDER pelvis, OFF ground. NO dark boot left behind the body. This is a tight PASSING pose, feet almost same horizontal coordinate.
2: far DARK knee unfolds to right and boot begins descent diagonally down, near LIGHT leg extends back a little. Far foot is halfway between raised passing and forward heel contact.
3: far DARK heel has landed at screen-right/front and sole settling; near LIGHT foot at screen-left/back rolls up on toe.
4: far DARK supporting leg becomes vertical under pelvis, front boot retracting backward in place; near LIGHT rear heel lifts off.
5: far DARK boot supports vertically directly under far hip; near LIGHT bent knee swings forward, its folded boot tucked CLOSE beside supporting calf, directly UNDER pelvis and OFF ground, foreground. This is the other tight PASSING pose.
6: near LIGHT knee unfolds right, boot descends halfway toward forward heel contact; far DARK leg extends slightly back.
7: near LIGHT heel has landed screen-right/front and settles, far DARK foot screen-left/back rolls onto toe. Leads into nextcycle.
Near leg ALWAYS foreground at crossings, far leg ALWAYS behind, never swap their depth. Near boot MEDIUM brown, far boot DARK brown, shades never swap. The support foot is always on ground; the passing free foot is not planted.
Same exact character as reference:45degree right-facing sideview, closed eyes and skin-colored pout, warm blonde angular bob, white highneck plain top with ONE broad graycelshadow, navy skirt, thick short charcoal legs and chunky brown boots. Hands clasped behindback. Same wholefigure scale and proportions across8. Natural small followthrough in whitehem, sleeves, hairtips, ahoge and golden tail. Redraw wholefigure percell, avoid frozen upperbody. DO NOT reproduce the same input key poses, specifically cells1 and5 must have FEET CLOSE TOGETHER in passing, rather than wide apart. Fullbody uncropped generous margins in allcells; no groundline, text, grid, gradient, props or shadows. True transparency.
guide_creation.assembly: Guide arranges intact full-body key and passing drawings. No body parts were cut apart.

ANATOMICAL CONTINUITY IS CRITICAL: the NEAR leg is attached to near hip on SCREEN-LEFT side of pelvis and its boot remains medium dark brown (#55433b) throughout. FAR leg attached screen-right side of pelvis and its boot remains slightly darker (#39302c). Near limb ALWAYS OCCLUDES far limb when crossing; never swap their depth or colors. Forward/back stride changes, camera depth ordering NEVER changes. NO extra leg, fused limb, flipped hips or reassigning boots.
16 gait poses around cycle:
0 near foot forward/right heel contact, far foot back/left toe-off.
1 near heel settles, far heel rises.
2 near stance flat under weight, far knee flexes behind.
3 far knee advances underneath hips behind near thigh.
4 far bent leg passes near support leg, boot lifted just ahead.
5 far lower leg unfolds forward/right.
6 far heel approaches right/front floor, near heel starts rising.
7 near foot rolls onto rear toe, far heel just above ground.
8 far foot forward/right heel contact, near foot back/left toe-off, opposite0 with near leg still foreground.
9 far heel settles, near heel rises.
10 far stance flat, near knee bends behind.
11 near knee advances under hips IN FRONT of far thigh.
12 near bent leg passes far support leg, boot lifted just ahead.
13 near lower leg unfolds forward/right.
14 near heel approaches front floor, far heel rises.
15 near heel just above floor, far rear toe, leading smoothly into0.
Actual natural walking, no repeated same-leg stamping. The supporting foot stays on shared baseline.
UPPER BODY MUST ANIMATE TOO: sleeve and hem have subtle rhythmic follow-through, back hair tips/ahoge lag a few millimeters, skirt tilts and flexes gently, tail counter-swings softly. No frozen head pasted on a torso, no rigid rotation of the entire character. Preserve face size. Consistent central hip location, sole ground level, whole-body scale in every cell. Full ears/ahoge/tail/soles INSIDE each cell with generous margins and transparent gaps. True alpha transparent background, no checkerboard painted in, no text/grid/numbers/ground/shadow/watermark.
